Resource forcing from n_pp_array

Source: R/rates.R
plankton_forcing.Rd

therMizer resource dynamics function that reads the time-varying plankton forcing stored in other_params(params)$n_pp_array.

Usage

plankton_forcing(params, t, ...)

Arguments

params

A MizerParams object that has been prepared for therMizer, typically with upgradeTherParams().

t

Numeric time in the same units as the first dimension of other_params(params)$ocean_temp. If t falls outside the supplied time series, the temperature series is recycled cyclically.

...

Additional arguments passed through by mizer's internal rate function machinery.

Value

A numeric vector of resource densities over params@w_full.

Details

The function selects the row corresponding to time t, converts the stored log-scale spectrum back to density with 10^x / params@dw_full, and sets bins above w_pp_cutoff to 0. If t falls outside the supplied time series, the series is recycled cyclically.
